vacuums.title: SharkClean Vacuum Devices
vacuums.description: The DSNs of the vacuums to add. Leave this empty to add every vacuum on your account (recommended unless you want to add only some of them).

europe.title: SharkClean European Server
europe.description: Set to true if you are located in Europe or the UK. SharkClean uses different servers for US and European regions.

externalAccessory.title: Publish as External Accessory
externalAccessory.description: When enabled, each vacuum is published as a standalone external accessory with its own HomeKit pairing code, instead of being bridged through Homebridge. Applies to both HAP and Matter registration modes.

preferMatter.title: Prefer Matter
preferMatter.description: When enabled, the plugin will use the Homebridge Matter API (requires Homebridge v2.0+ with Matter enabled). Falls back to HAP if Matter is unavailable.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter
enableMatter.description: Allow the plugin to use Homebridge Matter support when available. Set to false to always use HAP accessories.

items.helpvalue:
OAuth Code
Recommended: use the Homebridge UI OAuth Assistant in the plugin Settings tab to generate the login URL and exchange callback code automatically. You can still paste the OAuth code here manually if needed.

Vacuums
Enter SharkClean DSN(s) you want to add to HomeKit.

Homebridge Matter Support
These options require Homebridge v2.0 or later with Matter enabled. If Matter is unavailable the plugin will automatically fall back to standard HomeKit (HAP) accessories.
